backgrounds.name: the potential flow round two bodies
backgrounds.description: The potential flow round two bodies of a solar mass each, 200,000 km apart and at rest: space falls in from far away down the paths of things falling from rest, each body has a region of its own, and the dashed seam is where the regions meet. Between the bodies, space flows away from the seam on both sides. Arrows show the flow u; the colour its speed.

layers.label: the seam, where the bodies' regions of flow meet
